articles.title: Musk mulled handing OpenAI to his children, Altman testifies
articles.summary: Altman said that Musk's focus on controlling the initial for-profit gave him pause because OpenAI was dedicated to keeping advanced AI out of the hands of a single person, and Altman, with his experience running the prominent startup accelerator Y Combinator, knew "founders who had control usually did not give it up."

articles.title: Anthropic warns investors against secondary platforms offering access to its shares
articles.summary: "Any sale or transfer of Anthropic stock, or any interest in Anthropic stock, offered by these firms is void and will not be recognized on our books and records," the company's support page reads.

articles.title: Report: Google and SpaceX in talks to put data centers into orbit
articles.summary: Google and SpaceX are in talks to build data centers in orbit, pitching space as the future home for AI compute, even as costs today remain far higher than on the ground.

articles.title: Everything Google announced at its Android Show, from Googlebooks to vibe-coded widgets
articles.summary: Google unveiled its new AI-first Googlebooks laptops, more agentic Gemini features, vibe-coded Android widgets, Gemini in Chrome, refreshed Android Auto, and more ahead of I/O.

articles.title: Google adds Gemini-powered dictation to Gboard, which could be bad news for dictation startups
articles.summary: Google's transcription feature will initially launch with Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel phones.

articles.title: The AI legal services industry is heating up — Anthropic is getting in on the action
articles.summary: Anthropic's new tools are designed to help law firms automate specific clerical functions — things like document search and review, case law resources, deposition prep, document drafting, and other related areas.

articles.title: Google brings agentic AI and vibe-coded widgets to Android
articles.summary: Gemini Intelligence will also include Gboard-based dictation and form-filling capabilities.

articles.title: Google’s ‘Create My Widget’ feature will let you vibe-code your own widgets
articles.summary: To create a widget, users will be able to describe what they want using natural language. For example, you could ask the feature to "suggest three high-protein meal prep recipes every week" in order to get a custom dashboard that you can add and resize on your home screen.

articles.title: Threads tests a Meta AI integration that works similarly to Grok
articles.summary: The feature is designed to help people get real-time context about trends and breaking stories, as well as receive recommendations, all within conversations.

articles.title: Dessn raises $6M for its production-focused design tool
articles.summary: A new startup called Dessn has raised $6 million to build AI-powered design tools that work directly with production codebases.

articles.title: AI voice startup Vapi hits $500M valuation after winning Amazon Ring over 40 rivals
articles.summary: Vapi says its enterprise business has grown tenfold since early 2025 as companies shift customer support and sales calls to AI agents.

articles.title: Thinking Machines wants to build an AI that actually listens while it talks
articles.summary: Right now, every AI model you've ever used works the same way. You talk, it listens. It responds, you listen. Thinking Machines is trying to change that by building a model that processes your input and generates a response at the same time, so it's more like a phone call than a text chain.

articles.title: Riding an AI rally, Robinhood preps second retail venture IPO
articles.summary: Robinhood files confidentially for its second venture fund, this time targeting growth and early-stage startups.

articles.title: GM just laid off hundreds of IT workers to hire those with stronger AI skills
articles.summary: Some of the positions focus on AI-native development, data engineering and analytics, cloud-based engineering, and agent and model development as well as prompt engineering and new AI workflows.

articles.title: Digg tries again, this time as an AI news aggregator
articles.summary: In an email to beta testers, the company said the site's goal is to "track the most influential voices in a space" and to surface the news that's actually worth "paying attention to."

articles.title: There aren’t enough rockets for space data centers — Cowboy Space raised $275M to build them
articles.summary: The apparently insatiable demand for AI compute has data center entrepreneurs looking to the stars. There's a key problem: There aren't enough rockets to put data centers in orbit around Earth, and they're too expensive.

articles.title: Get ready for the whisper-filled office of the future
articles.summary: How will work setups change if we spend more and more time talking to our computers?

articles.title: Anthropic says ‘evil’ portrayals of AI were responsible for Claude’s blackmail attempts
articles.summary: Fictional portrayals of artificial intelligence can have a real effect on AI models, according to Anthropic.

articles.title: We’re feeling cynical about xAI’s big deal with Anthropic
articles.summary: On the latest episode of the Equity podcast, we discussed what xAI's deal with Anthropic might mean for parent company SpaceX.

articles.title: Voice AI in India is hard — Wispr Flow is betting on it anyway
articles.summary: Wispr Flow says growth accelerated in India after its Hinglish rollout, even as voice AI products continue to face challenges.

articles.title: China's Cold Atom Technology unveils 200-qubit dual-core neutral atom quantum computer
articles.summary: The company claims the Hanyuan-2 system is the first of its kind globally

articles.title: BT and StackIT partner on sovereign cloud in EU
articles.summary: Lidl owner's IT firm will provide cloud platform, BT will handle Internet connectivity

articles.title: Malaysia's NCT Alliance Berhad could sell 100-acre site for 800MW data center
articles.summary: Identity of operator is unclear

articles.title: UK's Kao Data acquires brownfield site in West London for data center development
articles.summary: Company buys site in Park Royal, previous owner aimed to build 35,000 sqm facility

articles.title: Lightpath secures contract to construct long-haul fiber route to connect Columbus and Chicago
articles.summary: The route will span approximately 392 route miles

articles.title: MobileX goes all in on AI as MVNO outlines global ambitions
articles.summary: The US-based MVNO is using AI to forecast the best data plans to meet customers' requirements

articles.title: TerraVolt inks natural gas supply deal for onsite power plant at planned data center campus in Idaho
articles.summary: Will support a campus of between 200 to 240MW

articles.title: Supercapacitor co. Skeleton Technologies raises €33m as it targets 2027 IPO
articles.summary: Power technology firm welcomes new investors

articles.title: University of Nebraska deploys Nvidia-powered GPU system dubbed PLUMAGE
articles.summary: Platform consists of six Nvidia H200 GPUs and 52 Nvidia L40S GPUs

articles.title: Satellite firm Aetherflux rebrands to Cowboy Space Corporation, raises $275m Series B
articles.summary: Robinhood luminary pursues vertical orbital data center/rocket empire, quintuples its Series-A

articles.title: Equinix to build its fourth Malaysian data center
articles.summary: $190m facility to be built close to existing KL1 facility

articles.title: Mavenir Telecom to deploy small cells for Georgian telco MagtiCom
articles.summary: Mavenir will support MagtiCom's nationwide small cells strategy

articles.title: NASA objects to Bezos’ Blue Origin’s 51,600 satellite “Project Sunrise” constellation
articles.summary: Space agency queries technical details of plan

articles.title: Data center to house supercomputer planned for university campus in Guimarães, Portugal
articles.summary: The infrastructure will be installed on the Azurém campus of the University of Minho

articles.title: John Malone offers to buy out GCI Liberty's proposed 6% stake in Liberty Latin America
articles.summary: Just days after GCI Liberty had announced it would buy a six percent stake in Liberty Latin America

articles.title: SiPearl and Semidynamics to develop EU-sovereign rack-scale compute platform
articles.summary: The platform will support AI inference workloads across both public and private European initiatives

articles.title: Deutsche Telekom employees go on strike in Germany amid pay dispute
articles.summary: Workers across the country have gone on strike

articles.title: Canada's Telus to expand Kamloops data center, lease two new sites in Vancouver
articles.summary: Company to take up Westbank's two data center projects in Vancouver

articles.title: Aussie investment firm Alceon launches data center fund, invests in Insite DC
articles.summary: Insite targeting sites in Sydney and Melbourne

articles.title: Amazon acquires leased data center in Virginia for $65 million
articles.summary: Company buys site from Menlo Equities

articles.title: Fluence Energy signs master supply agreements with two ‘major’ hyperscalers
articles.summary: Jefferies analyst Julien Dumoulin-Smith said the agreements came earlier than expected and represented “significant progress” on the company’s “emerging data center thesis.”

articles.title: Con Edison to spend $29B shoring up NYC area grid as electrification rises
articles.summary: New York City and its suburbs are not seeing an influx of data centers like other parts of the country, but building and transportation electrification is driving gradual demand growth.

articles.title: Making AI work for utilities means treating technology as a partner, not a replacement
articles.summary: In an era when reliability indices directly shape regulatory ratings, AI's predictive capability becomes a measurable operational asset, but only when people know how to use it, writes Sean Burri, a Dominion Energy infrastructure engineer.

articles.title: Hyperscalers driving record clean energy deals: CEBA CEO
articles.summary: U.S. corporate clean energy procurement surpassed 27 gigawatts in 2025, with four companies accounting for about three-quarters of that capacity, Rich Powell, CEO of the newly rebranded Corporate Energy Buyers Association, said in an interview.

articles.title: SPP, PJM, CAISO anticipate being able to meet power demand this summer
articles.summary: The regions in each organization’s footprint are likely to see higher-than-average temperatures this summer, but supply is expected to reliably meet demand.

articles.title: Constellation Energy enters 5 GW of nuclear, gas, battery capacity in PJM queue
articles.summary: Some potential data center customers are pausing decision-making in the PJM Interconnection to see how the grid operator’s colocation and backstop auction rules shake out, company officials said.

articles.title: Vistra adds 4.5 GW of capacity in line with ‘reasonable’ forecasts for PJM, ERCOT
articles.summary: “While these views remain below many third-party forecasts and ISO projections, they reflect what we believe to be the pace of physical development,” Vistra CEO Jim Burke said of the company’s load growth projections.

articles.title: PPL ‘advanced’ data center pipeline grows to 28.3 GW in Pennsylvania
articles.summary: A PPL-Blackstone joint venture is securing gas turbines for power plants that would serve data centers, company officials said.

articles.title: Competitive power markets have delivered. Abandoning them would be a mistake.
articles.summary: Electricity markets are not perfect, but they remain one of the most powerful tools we have for delivering reliable, affordable power at scale, writes former FERC Commissioner Nora Mead Brownell.

articles.title: Owning the full stack: What U.S. storage has to figure out next
articles.summary: Storage is no longer about the breakthrough tech, but who can build and deliver a system at scale.

articles.title: USA to examine SMRs for commercial shipping
articles.summary: The US Department of Transportation's Maritime Administration agency has launched an initiative to develop small modular reactors for use in commercial shipping.

articles.title: Rostekhnadzor approves Kursk II's first unit's readiness
articles.summary: Russian nuclear regulator Rostekhnadzor has issued a certificate of compliance for the first VVER-TOI reactor unit at the new phase of the Kursk nuclear power plant.

articles.title: First unit at San'ao enters commercial operation
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the San'ao nuclear power plant has entered commercial operation, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Zhejiang province.

articles.title: Cold tests completed for Lufeng 5
articles.summary: The successful completion of cold functional tests on unit 5, an HPR1000 (Hualong One) reactor, at Lufeng Nuclear Power Plant in China's Guangdong province, has been announced by China General Nuclear.

articles.title: Fuel loading begins at Changjiang 3
articles.summary: The initial loading of fuel assemblies into the core of unit 3 at the Changjiang nuclear power plant is under way. It is the first of two Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors under construction as the second phase of the site in China's Hainan province.

articles.title: Darlington SMR project's foundation module milestone
articles.summary: The giant Basemat module, which will serve as the foundation of the reactor building for the first small modular reactor to be built in a G7 country, has been set into place 35 metres below ground in the excavated reactor building shaft.

articles.title: Key AERB approval issued for Kudankulam 5 and 6
articles.summary: India's Atomic Energy Regulatory Board has issued permission for the installation of major equipment, including the reactor pressure vessel, steam generators and coolant pumps, at Kudankulam nuclear power plant units 5 and 6.

articles.title: Norwegian municipalities initiate investigation work
articles.summary: Several municipalities in Norway that have submitted proposals to the Ministry of Energy for possible nuclear power plants based on small modular reactors have decided to initiate investigation work for the projects and prepare technical reports that will form the basis for future licence applications.

articles.title: Fuel loading completed at two new Chinese units
articles.summary: The initial loading of fuel assemblies into the cores of Taipingling unit 2 and Changjiang unit 3 - both Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors - has been completed ahead of their start-ups.

articles.title: Permission granted for commissioning work on Akkuyu 2
articles.summary: Turkey's nuclear regulator has granted a permit for commissioning work to take place on the second unit at the Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant.

articles.title: Funding boost for Bruce C pre-development work
articles.summary: Ontario's government has announced a cost-sharing and recovery agreement enabling Bruce Power to move ahead with an estimated CAD300 million (USD220 million) of pre-development work for the Bruce C new nuclear project.

articles.title: Concreting completed of Kursk II's third reactor building foundation
articles.summary: Rosatom says that the pouring of concrete for the foundation of the third unit at Kursk II nuclear power plant has been completed ahead of schedule.

articles.title: Construction begins on fourth Taipingling unit
articles.summary: The first nuclear safety-related concrete has been poured for the reactor building of unit 4 at the Taipingling nuclear power plant in Huizhou in south China's Guangdong province. It is the fourth of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site.

articles.title: Rosatom continuing work for Iran’s Bushehr units 2 and 3
articles.summary: The reactor for Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant’s unit 2 is more than 60% complete and the steam generators 50% complete, and "we plan to begin shipping the key equipment next year", Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev has said.

articles.title: Nuclear fuel loading completed at Rooppur 1
articles.summary: The process of loading 163 nuclear fuel assemblies into Bangladesh's first nuclear power plant reactor has been completed.

articles.title: Experiments provide data for SMR passive cooling system simulations
articles.summary: Researchers at Switzerland's Paul Scherrer Institute have experimentally investigated passive cooling systems for small modular reactors, collecting high-resolution measurement data for the first time.

articles.title: US NRC clears St Lucie 1 and 2 for 80-years operation
articles.summary: Florida's St Lucie Nuclear Power Plant units 1 and 2 have been approved to operate to 2056 and 2063, respectively, after the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission issued subsequent licence renewals.

articles.title: Licensing of US pilot SMRs advances
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy's Idaho Operations Office has approved the Documented Safety Analysis for Aalo Atomics' Aalo-X experimental reactor. Meanwhile, the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission has approved the Principal Design Criteria topical report for Oklo's Aurora powerhouse.

articles.title: Site of Polish plant deemed suitable
articles.summary: The Lubiatowo-Kopalino site is a suitable location for Poland's first nuclear power plant, the president of the National Atomic Energy Agency has determined after examining the Preliminary Site Report for the facility.

articles.title: Norwegian state expedites Kjeller licence transfer
articles.summary: The Norwegian government is to accelerate the process of transferring the nuclear facilities at Kjeller from the Institute of Energy Technology to Norwegian Nuclear Decommissioning. The transfer could now take place as soon as 1 January 2027.
